news.title: Starling Bank Cuts 130 Jobs as AI Restructuring Redefines UK Banking Workforce
news.body: Starling Bank will eliminate around 130 positions as it automates core functions and integrates AI across its operations. The layoffs directly impact staff in targeted roles and mark a concrete shift toward digital-first banking in the UK. Major UK challenger banks such as Monzo and Revolut face pressure to accelerate their own AI adoption to maintain cost competitiveness and operational efficiency. This move establishes a new benchmark for workforce transformation in UK fintech.

news.title: IMF Warns Tokenization Shifts Risk From Banks to Market Infrastructure Providers
news.body: The IMF cautioned that financial tokenization could transfer systemic risk from banks to market infrastructure providers, urging policymakers to adapt oversight frameworks. This warning prompts banks, payment service providers (PSPs), and regulators to reassess tokenization strategies and risk management. Market infrastructure providers, such as clearinghouses and settlement platforms, may soon face new compliance requirements and closer regulatory scrutiny as tokenized assets gain traction in mainstream payments.

news.title: Signicat and TrustTech Bring Reusable Identity Verification to European Digital Wallets
news.body: Signicat and TrustTech have partnered to embed reusable identity verification into European digital wallets, aiming to boost security and regulatory compliance. Digital wallet providers gain a new tool to reduce onboarding friction and fraud risk, while users benefit from streamlined authentication. Competing wallet platforms, including Apple Pay and Google Wallet, may need to enhance their security features to retain user trust. The partnership could set a new standard for digital identity in EU payments.

news.title: Oman Arab Bank Completes Visa Tokenization Rollout to Modernize Card Security
news.body: Oman Arab Bank has finished deploying Visa tokenization across its card portfolio, advancing its payments modernization agenda. Customers now benefit from enhanced transaction security and reduced fraud exposure. Regional banks such as Bank Muscat and National Bank of Oman are likely to accelerate their own tokenization projects to remain competitive in payment security. The rollout positions Oman Arab Bank as a leader in Middle Eastern payment security standards.

news.title: eDreams ODIGEO Partners With Visa to Enable AI Agents for Travel Purchases
news.body: eDreams ODIGEO (eDO) has teamed up with Visa to let AI-powered agents book travel services directly, streamlining the purchase process for users. This integration gives eDO a competitive edge in travel payments and may drive higher customer satisfaction. Competing travel platforms such as Booking.com and Expedia are likely to pursue similar AI partnerships to avoid losing market share. The move signals a new phase of automation in travel commerce.

perspective: Starling Bank layoffs and the IMF’s tokenization warning illustrate how AI and digital assets are shifting risk and strategy for banks and payment providers.
